title: UvA staff/student/FNV strike and march (fourth day)
reason: The continuous strike began Dec 9, outside this unit’s onset window; demand addressed university board/employer and ties with Israeli organizations, not Dutch government/policy.
notes: Recorded as a pre-month continuation separately; few hundred reported at Dec 12 action.

title: XR action inside Rijksmuseum
reason: Reported demand targeted Rijksmuseum sponsorship by ING, a museum/corporate relationship rather than domestic-state policy.
notes: NOS reports XR claimed 200 at the action. Do not treat police ending the action as state-target eligibility.
